name: Narrative clarification relative trade
hypothesis: Buy the verified eligible asset only after primary clarification and demand-backed relative outperformance.
spec: Setup: A verified clarification may differentiate an original token from confusing alternatives. Entry: Buy the verified eligible asset only after primary clarification and demand-backed relative outperformance. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when relative strength reverses or identity evidence becomes uncertain. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable.
